description: Build-and-ship: story splitting, implementation with adversarial review, test plans, triage, migrations, launch readiness, release notes, agent-policy files, and code-quality gates.

prerequisites: A git repository with changes on a branch
The reviewer subagents, for the full panel: `skilldrop install --panel review` (the Claude plugin includes them)
first-value.starter-task: Find out whether your current branch is safe to merge
first-value.starter-prompt: Is this branch safe to merge? Run a pre-merge review on the current diff.
first-value.verification: pre-merge-review runs the project's lint, typecheck and tests through its gate script, then the reviewer panel, and ends with READY or NOT READY.
first-value.recovery: If the gate script cannot find your lint or test commands, tell it what they are. If the panel is skipped, install the reviewer subagents with `skilldrop install --panel review`.
